summary: The scoped E01–E09 master program is executable with preserved baselines, exact command-prefix matching, fixed subprocess commands, required predecessor evidence and a bounded agent repair cycle. This is a skeptical author review; independent legal and bank approval are outside scope.

findings.risk: Unbounded or unreviewed shell execution through the runner
findings.disposition: Resolved: commands are fixed argv lists, phase names are enumerated, notes are project-local JSON, no shell or free-form command argument is accepted.
Repaired before execution: RUNNING refuses a new attempt; recover retains a counted failure and uses PID/start identity before terminating the recorded process group.

findings.risk: Retry reported as repair without an explicit intervention
findings.disposition: Resolved in workflow: failed execution creates REPAIR_REQUIRED; agent must record diagnosis, executed changes and regression before another reviewed attempt. Up to six failures are allowed and logs cannot be overwritten.

findings.risk: Stale phase plans or a next phase ignoring previous failures
findings.disposition: Resolved: review binds exact current source and plan; predecessors must pass; success writes a refreshed next plan carrying prior attempts/repairs. Each implementation phase then refreshes against its actual new code.

findings.risk: Schema examples used as proof of production behavior
findings.disposition: Resolved: P1–P3 implement actual persistence/controller/service tests; P4 runs complete regression, Java, browser and packaging checks. Live-model effectiveness remains unassessed.

findings.risk: Release allowed before interpretation report exists or through old API
findings.disposition: Implementation obligation fixed: bind investigation-origin candidate bundles immediately; hook the existing release service and review path; all linked investigations or explicitly reviewed successor dispositions must be checked.

findings.risk: Original acceptance evidence invalidated by intentional source changes
findings.disposition: Resolved: 153 baseline files copied and 350 retained evidence files hashed. New acceptance has a separate ledger; no modification to the old oracle or old run manifests is allowed.

findings.risk: Hidden scientific defaults and unfair method comparison
findings.disposition: No method ranking is attempted. Python/Java/SQLite are inherited prototype choices; fixture budgets and six phase repair failures are explicit engineering bounds. Independent held-out evaluation remains E11–E12.

findings.risk: Sandbox-induced thread failure or broad permission expansion
findings.disposition: Use one exact absolute runner prefix in trusted context. Local codex execpolicy check confirms this command matches and arbitrary Python does not. The official docs fetch was unavailable (502/503; HTTP 403), so syntax was checked against the installed CLI and existing local rules.

baseline: T00–T22 local synthetic MVP; 154 retained tests
required_future_evidence: P4 complete acceptance and next-round refresh
